_comment_body: How the agent attaches to a world. P0 targets 'clientmod': a real Forge client + the agent-client control mod, which is the only way onto a Forge server (mineflayer speaks the vanilla protocol and gets rejected). 'mineflayer' is still available for vanilla/Paper servers; 'mock' is the scripted test world. Switch with --body or the MC_BODY env var.
_comment_clientMod: HTTP control endpoint exposed by the agent-client mod inside the running Forge client. Nothing here needs a Java rebuild; the mod already implements every verb P0 uses.
_comment_taskGoal: 玩家下发的任务（!chop/!mine/语言脑派发）入队成功后，给动作脑创建一个 DSH goal（执行+监督，明确不重复 Node 侧动作）；同一时间只允许一个活跃 goal，同命令 10 秒内不重复创建，maxGoalRounds 限制成本。没有活跃动作脑时会跳过并记日志。
_comment_screenshot: 事件驱动截图：失败/卡住（plan:partial、plan:failed、task:failed、连续同因失败）、计划或提案接受（执行前状态）、新维度/首次见到的模组方块 -> 截 1 张；另每 90 秒最多 1 张兜底，仅在动作脑有活跃任务时。每任务上限 maxPerTask、全局最小间隔 minIntervalMs、感知哈希去重 dedupeDistance（汉明距离）、目录只保留 keepFiles 张。截图以 steer 消息（harnessBridge.forward）把路径插进动作脑对话，并写 .json 旁注；判定仍以结构化状态为准，图只作辅助证据。maxEdge 768 约 380KB/张。
_comment_miningRecovery: LLM exception recovery for mining (docs/MINING-LLM-PLAN.md §5.8). Stays OFF until the offline matrix and the controlled live run pass; while off, the triggers are logged and the macro fails honestly instead of calling a model. Budgets here are ceilings - the parent task deadline always wins.
_comment_miningCollection: Shared pickup loop (docs/MINING-COLLECTION-PLAN.md §七). 'unresolvedPolicy: stop' means an uncollected product stops the task honestly instead of being silently written off.
_comment_pathfinding: Deliverable A. A* runs over the mod's own block scan (49x49x17 cells). allowDig stays false in P0: a conservative noPath beats a route the bot cannot actually walk. jumpStreakLimit: after this many failed jump/step-up legs the walker stops jumping and reports jump-blocked instead. maxSidesteps: how many times a blocked route may be answered with a short step in a different direction before giving up. trace is the JSONL file the panel counts.
_comment_planner: M3 test policy: local planner is OFF. The DeepSeek harness is the only autonomous proposal/plan generator; it proposes via mc_propose and executes plans via mc_plan. Explicit !commands still run with mode='off'. proposalCooldownMs is how long a rejected/expired target is not proposed again; proposalTtlMs is how long a question waits for an answer (no answer is NOT consent). autonomousProposals injects a proposal-prep goal after idleMs without a blocking explicit task; the action brain must read the full client state and return mc_propose(autonomous); responseMs is the approval window and reject/timeout waits idleMs again. It never executes without approval.

autonomousProposals._comment_curriculum: Voyager-style automatic curriculum (src/planner/curriculum.js): the prep goal carries completed/failed tasks and a difficulty band (level grows every bandStep completed tasks, cap maxLevel); below-band proposals are refused up to maxRejections times, then relaxed. The ledger persists to file.

_comment_state: P1 M3/A17/A29 live entry. enabled=true turns on atomic session persistence so the M3 restart items can be tested: plans, proposals (pending question), event ring, budgets, methods/answers/memory are written to path (temp+rename); a corrupt file is renamed to .corrupt-<ts> and ignored. In-flight tasks/turns are never restored, and restore never starts a plan. Offline Brain suites run with P1_STATE=off so they cannot read or write this file.
_comment_codeSkills: M4 live loop. enabled=true instantiates CodeSkillService: real generation writes candidates/, trial runs in a permissioned Node child (SandboxRunner) with capability RPC, evidence goes to runtime/code-skill-runs/. No per-action approval; the sandbox timeout/call budget/permission list stay enforced. Generated code is static-scanned and never required by the parent. search uses the DeepSeek Search API with the llm baseUrl/apiKey; results are untrusted data and cached for review.

codeSkills._comment_repair: M4 v3：生成物是键鼠脚本（input_* 权限）；manifest 四元组 code+description+preconditions+verification；试运行失败把错误原文回灌重生成，最多 maxRounds=4 轮，每轮一个新 patch 版本（不覆盖）。allowLegacyBody=false 可禁跑 v1/v2 旧技能。
codeSkills._comment_forge: 动作脑自主取脚本（2026-10-29 操作员决定）：!code-skill forge <需求> 后台跑 ≤4 轮生成+试运行+verification，成功即自动晋升（autoPromote）。沙箱/证据/权限不变。
codeSkills._comment_retrieval: 检索：描述即键，默认本地哈希 TF-IDF 向量 + 余弦相似度（embedding.provider=http 可接 OpenAI 兼容 /embeddings）；query=上下文+最近失败/chatlog（Voyager voyager.py:245-249）。

_comment_chat: Two input channels: prefix '!' is the deterministic command fast-path, dialogueTrigger goes to the LLM. Other chat is normally ignored; `participate=true` (P1 M6) lets the language half decide whether to join ordinary multiplayer chat, and `proposalChat=true` lets a standalone yes/no answer the pending proposal. conversationGuard applies to opt-in LLM replies; it is independent of the participation switch. dialogueTrigger is left null so the persona file's own frontmatter decides - that keeps a character swap from silently killing the in-game channel. Every non-command player line is also written to ChatMemory (A17); `!` commands and the agent's own account are excluded.
_comment_language: Language-brain owner (docs/LANGUAGE-BRAIN-REPAIR.md). 'unified' (default since 2026-10-23) routes every non-'!' player line through src/llm/languageBrain.js (roleplay/expert/approval profiles); 'legacy' keeps the old P0/P1 wiring as a rollback. Tools stay language-only: say/silence/approve/lookup_item/web_search/grep_chat_memory/grep_task_memory.
_comment_proactive: Role-play: the bot speaks without being spoken to. taskDone is event-driven (brain task events, player-sourced only); hungry and lowHealth are states, so they are polled with per-trigger cooldowns - without a cooldown a starving bot would repeat forever. Every unprompted line goes through LlmCore.speakUp, which drops any action the model proposes, so these triggers can never start work.
_comment_death: Death aborts every task and alerts outside the game (console + panel + state file). Recovery is ALWAYS manual - the panel's resume button or POST /command {"command":"resume"} - so there is no autoResume key: a respawn must never restart work on its own.
_comment_web: Control panel. port null means 'bridgePort + 1'; set an explicit port to run a second agent on the same machine.

The panel and the task-event stream share one server (P1 Q1: a second listener would race the port+1 fallback). eventsToken: when set, GET /events requires ?token= or 'Authorization: Bearer'; empty means localhost-only like the rest of the panel. testHooks: enables the A28 injection endpoint POST /harness/inject for duplicate/out-of-order turn events - keep false on a production agent (P1_TEST_HOOKS=on also enables it for offline fixtures).

bot._comment_external: To play on an EXTERNAL multiplayer server, change host/port and set auth to 'microsoft' (public servers are online-mode=true). Optional: 'proxy': 'socks5://user:pass@host:1080'. See docs/EXTERNAL-SERVERS.md
bot._comment_auth: This server needs a real Forge client (see body.kind='clientmod'). AuthMe login happens in-game via chat, see auth section below.
bot._comment_NEVER_REGISTER: registerOnMissing MUST stay false. On an AuthMe server a /register for an existing name RESETS that character (experience and inventory are wiped). Authentication is /login only. Four independent gates enforce this: ControlHttpServer, ClientActions, ClientModBody.isForbidden and the CLI, plus the mod's own refusal.
bot._comment_authmePassword: NEVER put the password in this file - it is tracked by git. Put it in the untracked overlay config/agent.local.json ({"bot":{"authme":{"password":"..."}}}) so start.ps1 keeps auto-login working, or export MC_AUTHME_PASSWORD. A null password makes the AuthMe module report 'not configured' and skip, never guess.

behaviour._comment_screens: autoCloseScreens only ever closes a CONTAINER screen (chest/furnace/crafting/...) so the agent can walk. Chat, the Escape menu, options, anvils, signs, books and anything unrecognised belong to the operator and are waited on, never dismissed - set false to refuse even containers and report screen-open instead. chatScreenWaitMs is how long it waits for a screen that is not ours.
behaviour._comment_engage: Wounded below this health the reflex engages the nearest hostile instead of waiting for it to close in - the gun era wants the fight started on our terms (COMBAT-PLAN v3).
behaviour._comment_engageRadius: Active reflex radius: XZ is horizontal blocks (operator request 2026-10-18: 15). Y keeps the original +-4 window from the attack skill; do not use the 24-block Euclidean scan radius for engagement.
behaviour._comment_public: On public servers: keep a low profile. autoFight off is often wiser, and chat responses should be rare.

_comment_safety: Staying away from player-built terrain. avoidManMade refuses planks/chests/farms/machines by name and keeps routes off built floors - cheap, and it never blocks digging dirt or stone. strictMining adds structural anti-masonry heuristics ('is this stone a wall?') and is OFF by default because it also refuses ordinary exposed surfaces. requireLeaves makes a bare trunk (no leaves/nether wart nearby) count as NOT a tree, so a player's log pillar is never chopped - it is the cheapest way to tell a forest from a lumber yard. OPERATOR DECISION (2026-10-03): avoidManMade is OFF - the pathfinder must be free to walk over the operator's own base and farm; the per-call allowManMade options in the skills stay as documentation of intent.
_comment_survival: allowWoodChopping=false stops the *planner* from felling trees on its own; an explicit !chop from chat still works. There is no allowDirtDigging: the always-available dirt fallback goal was removed by the operator, so an idle planner now simply idles rather than rearranging the ground. Explicit !mine dirt still works.

survival._comment_mods: On modded servers unknown blocks are only mined when a name signature suggests a normal block.
